options.rationale: Correct: the Basic Flowchart template provides flowchart shapes and connectors.

Starting from a fitting template is recommended over a blank page.

items.stem: Which TWO are good practices when building a Visio flowchart? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Use dynamic connectors that stay attached to shapes
options.rationale: Correct: dynamic connectors keep the diagram connected when shapes move.

options.text: Use shapes from the appropriate stencil for the diagram type
options.rationale: Correct: using the correct stencil keeps diagrams valid and consistent.

options.text: Mix shapes from incompatible workflow templates
options.rationale: Incorrect: mixing incompatible stencils breaks workflow diagrams.

options.text: Avoid labeling shapes to keep diagrams clean
options.rationale: Incorrect: labels communicate each step's purpose.

items.explanation: Correct: dynamic connectors keep the diagram connected when shapes move.
